subject: Barry shared KB
object: community solution lessons as anonymized JSONL source records that are reviewed through Git before publication

subject: Shared KB snapshots
object: manifest, manifest signature, lesson JSONL, revocation JSONL, and search index files for vendor-neutral static snapshot distribution to any static host or a Brain's /v1/snapshot endpoint

subject: Shared KB search
object: trusted lessons while allowing reviewed lessons only through an explicit include-reviewed option

subject: Shared KB validation
object: revealing file paths, email addresses, secret-looking tokens, malformed records, and duplicate lesson IDs before publication

subject: Shared KB contribution
object: local-only mode so Barry does not send shared KB contributions unless the user explicitly opts in

subject: Shared KB contribution mode
object: .barry-cache/config.json as repo-local user config with local_only, preview_only, or share_enabled values

subject: barry-cache kb sharing
object: shared KB contribution status and set commands using local-only, preview-only, and share-enabled CLI mode names

subject: Remote shared KB search
object: share-enabled contribution mode, while local shared KB snapshot search remains available in every mode

subject: Barry Brain server
object: a vendor-neutral HTTP contract (healthz, intake, search, snapshot, attest, lesson) for the distributed shared KB, reusing shared-kb schema, validation, redaction, and Ed25519 signing

subject: Barry Brain core
object: a portable Web Fetch API handler plus a BrainStore persistence interface so the same code can run on multiple runtimes and storage backends

subject: Brain v1
object: a single Docker container backed by bun:sqlite with no external services and no new runtime dependencies

subject: Each Brain
object: its own Ed25519 keypair whose public-key fingerprint clients pin to verify snapshot signatures end-to-end without a central authority

subject: Brain trust policy
object: company mode that makes submitted lessons usable immediately, while global mode stores submissions as reviewed pending a later staged-maturation engine

subject: Brain conformance suite
object: that any deployment satisfies the vendor-neutral Brain contract via the barry-brain conformance command

subject: Shared KB intake batches
object: a recursive stable-stringify canonical payload so the Ed25519 signature binds the full lesson and attestation contents; the same module is shared by the client and the Brain to prevent drift

subject: Barry shared KB client
object: a local Ed25519 validator identity in .barry-cache/shared-kb/identity.json, anonymized lesson proposals queued to a repo-local outbox, and a signed intake batch POSTed to a Brain /v1/intake endpoint

subject: barry-cache kb propose and kb submit
object: proposal creation on preview-only or share-enabled mode and submission to a Brain on share-enabled mode, reading the target from --brain or shared_kb.brain.url

subject: Shared KB brain descriptor
object: .barry-cache/config.json as shared_kb.brain with url, scope (private or global), and optional trust_policy so a repo points Barry at a chosen Brain

subject: barry-cache kb harvest
object: a candidate lesson, a value gate, and a sanitization checklist from the latest finalize handoff or validation failure, leaving abstraction and confirmation to the agent via kb propose (agent-in-the-loop, no LLM in Barry)

subject: Shared KB harvest
object: preview-only or share-enabled mode, and a successful finalize nudges the agent to run kb harvest only when sharing is enabled

subject: Shared KB attestations
object: signed outcome records (confirmed/contradicted/not_applicable x observed_success/observed_failure/static_review) that the Brain binds to their signing key by deriving validator_id and rejecting mismatches, so reputation cannot be stolen or fabricated

subject: Shared KB reputation
object: lesson scores as a sigmoid of signed, evidence-weighted (observed_failure>observed_success>static_review), copied-evidence-discounted attestation contributions, and validator reputation as agreement with the resulting scores in a single pass

subject: Shared KB staged maturation
object: reviewed lessons to trusted only with enough independent confirmations across diverse contexts, a positive score, and a minimum observation window, and demotes to challenged on a credible observed_failure that drives the score net-negative; terminal statuses are never auto-changed

subject: Brain self-validation
object: trust_policy global by re-scoring and re-maturing lessons after each accepted attestation or intake, while company policy keeps immediate trust and skips maturation

subject: barry-cache kb attest
object: a signed outcome attestation for a consumed lesson to a Brain /v1/attest endpoint, gated on share-enabled mode (attestation-on-use)

subject: barry-cache kb harvest --source context
object: the existing context backlog (active decision facts, active ADRs, recorded validation failures) into sanitization candidates, excluding implemented/test facts, superseded records, and src file pointers, then flows through the agent-in-the-loop propose path

subject: Existing Barry context
object: abstracted, sanitized lessons via filtered agent-in-the-loop harvest, never as a raw dump of canonical facts, because canonical context is project-specific and source-backed

subject: barry-cache kb propose
object: the lesson, anti_pattern, and decision_pattern kinds via --kind so harvested decisions and failures keep their taxonomy

subject: Barry shared KB direction
object: interoperate with Mozilla cq as a signed, provenance-carrying contributor and consumer through a versioned adapter (Barry lesson maps to cq knowledge_unit), retire the standalone global Brain, signed-snapshot distribution, and self-validation/reputation engine, and keep Barry's lesson format canonical as the hedge against cq churn
